basic_details.job_title: Kalaburagi District Court Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 29 Peon, Typist and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Peon, Typist, Stenographer Grade-3 and 1 more
basic_details.short_information: Kalaburagi District Court, Karnataka, has invited applications for 29 posts in 4 roles under Advt No. 25/2026, 20/2026, 19/2026, 22/2026. The posts include Peon, Typist, Stenographer Grade-3, Typist-Copyist. The online application is open from 16 November 2026 to 15 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online payment through SBI e-pay (net banking / credit card / debit card / UPI). Last date to pay the fee: 17 December 2026.

age_limit.age_details: 18 to 35 years (as on last date fixed for receipt of applications)

qualification.education_qualification: 7th, SSLC/10th, Diploma, Shorthand and Typewriting qualifications as applicable per post

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Must have passed S.S.L.C. or equivalent examination. Age limit: 18 to 35 years. Pay: 27000-43300. Qualification required: Diploma in Commercial Practice / SSLC with Senior Grade Typewriting. Age limit: 18 to 35 years. Pay: 34100-52800. Qualification required: Diploma in Commercial Practice or equivalent; Senior Grade Kannada and English Shorthand and Typewriting examinations. Age limit: 18 to 35 years. Pay: 44425-83700. Qualification required: Diploma in Commercial Practice / SSLC with Junior Grade Typewriting. Age limit: 18 to 35 years. Pay: 34100-52800.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 27,000 to Rs. 83,700, depending on the post

how_to_apply: Visit the official website link provided for online recruitment.
Read all instructions carefully before filling out the online application form.
Upload scanned photograph and signature as per prescribed specifications.
Submit the application and pay the fee through SBI e-pay / net banking / UPI.
Download and print the completed application and SBI e-payment receipt for future reference.
important_instructions: Applications submitted with false details or fake documents will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Kalaburagi District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 15 December 2026. Applications opened on 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Kalaburagi District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 29 vacancies: 15 Peon, 10 Typist, 1 Stenographer Grade-3, 3 Typist-Copyist.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Kalaburagi District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General Category: Rs. 200. Category-2a, 2b, 3a, 3b: Rs. 100. SC, ST, Category-1, PWD: Exempted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 35 years (as on last date fixed for receipt of applications). Relaxation: Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B 3, SC, ST, Category-1 5.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 27000-43300 for Peon, 34100-52800 for Typist, 44425-83700 for Stenographer Grade-3, 34100-52800 for Typist-Copyist.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 7th, SSLC/10th, Diploma, Shorthand and Typewriting qualifications as applicable per post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must know how to read and write Kannada. Local cadre reservation (371-J) applies.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Skill Test / Competitive Examination. Interview / Viva-Voce. Skill test followed by interview carrying 10 marks.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 2 years probation period.
